description: Closure decisions for remaining React style={{ }} usages. Every file with remaining inline style usage must have a reason here.

src/components/AppHeader.tsx.reason: runtime dropdown positioning is computed from viewport/header measurements.

src/components/UserMenu.tsx.reason: menu position and role color CSS variable are runtime values used by the shared account menu.

src/components/common/ProductSearchInput.reason: search results popup uses runtime anchor geometry and viewport bounds.

src/components/common/SearchableOptionsP.reason: options popup uses runtime anchor geometry and viewport bounds.

src/components/common/SupplierSelect.tsx.reason: supplier picker popup uses runtime anchor geometry and viewport bounds.

src/modules/Dashboard/components/Dashboa.reason: calendar day background/accent color is computed from day intensity and special-day data.
occasion color is imported/user data and must remain runtime-driven.
special day color is user data and must remain runtime-driven.

src/modules/Dashboard/overview/component.reason: breakdown row color comes from chart/series data.
tooltip label color comes from the active chart payload.

src/modules/Orders/components/ItemsRepor.reason: item report mini chart uses runtime percentage/color values.

src/modules/Orders/components/SalesRepor.reason: sales report bar height is computed from live quantity ratios.

src/modules/Owner/components/OwnerFilter.reason: owner filter chip color is derived from company/series data.

src/modules/Owner/components/OwnerPerfor.reason: tooltip rows and legend dots use Recharts payload/company series runtime colors.

src/modules/Purchases/batch/components/P.reason: print/summary column alignment is selected from column metadata.

src/modules/Reports/BankStatementMapping.reason: bank statement preview min-width is computed from detected/imported columns.

src/modules/Reports/GeneralPlTable.tsx.reason: P&L row and sticky backgrounds are runtime hierarchy tones in a protected financial matrix.

src/modules/Reports/ReportsDetailModal.t.reason: report detail chart cell styling is derived from selected chart payload data.

src/modules/Reports/bank/BankCategoryCar.reason: bank category type colors come from category/type metadata.

src/modules/Reports/bank/components/anal.reason: progress width and color are runtime values from analysis ratios.
bar chart height is computed from rendered category count.
pie legend dot uses chart/category series color.
tooltip title color comes from Recharts payload fill.

src/modules/Settings/components/AppBrand.reason: branding preview swatch uses the selected runtime brand color.

src/ui/KebabMenu.tsx.reason: shared kebab menu position and height are computed from trigger geometry and viewport.

src/ui/MatrixTable.tsx.reason: MatrixTable centralizes runtime matrix sizing, numeric alignment, fixed first column, row accents, and heat cell styling.

src/ui/MetricCard.tsx.reason: MetricCard supports an explicit runtime color prop as part of its public API.

src/ui/SimpleTable.tsx.reason: SimpleTable exposes runtime maxHeight/minWidth and column alignment/padding knobs.

src/ui/SmartTable/SmartTable.tsx.reason: SmartTable computes runtime sizing, padding, row numbering, row styling, and sortable header states.

src/ui/SmartTable/buildFooterCells.tsx.reason: SmartTable footer row-number cell mirrors runtime table padding and width.
